ImageDescription.value:
Crab meat fried rice - Me Dee Thai restaurant -AUD10.

Good fried rice. Unremarkable crab meat. A very Thai place. A lot of their customers spoke Thai. Unfortunately, we found the food too sweet (sugary).

We then took a walk along Mordialloc Pier. A cool change from the hot and sticky days we've just had.

Me Dee Thai Market Square Shopping Centre

St Johns Ave, Springvale 3171

190208547.title: File:DFC 2078 A plate of shrimp pad Thai garnished with lime bean sprouts scallions and crushed peanuts.jpg

ObjectName.value: DFC 2078 A plate of shrimp pad Thai garnished with lime bean sprouts scallions and crushed peanuts

Categories.value: Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|Flickr images reviewed by FlickreviewR 2|Nong Pla Lai|Street food in Pattaya

ImageDescription.value: This appears to be a beautifully plated dish of Pad Thai, a classic Thai stir-fried noodle dish. The main portion features rice noodles coated in a rich orange-colored sauce, topped with several large pink shrimp. On the side of the blue-gray plate are fresh bean sprouts, green scallions, and a wedge of lime for squeezing over the dish. There's also a small white bowl in the upper corner containing what looks like crushed peanuts, which are traditionally sprinkled on Pad Thai before eating. This presentation includes all the classic components of the popular Thai street food dish, allowing the diner to customize their meal by adding the accompaniments to taste.
